newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CDW parent to buy out minority shareholders.
newsitem.headline: CDW parent to buy out minority shareholders.

text.p: CDW International Ltd said on Thursday that its controlling shareholder CDW Holdings Ltd was offering to buy all shares held by minority shareholders for HK$1.20 per share.

CDW Holdings and parties acting in concert with it own about 74.91 percent of CDW International's issued shares and after the offering will request a withdrawal of the listing of CDW International shares on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong, CDW International said in a statement.
Trading in its shares was suspended on February 3. The stock last traded at HK$0.76.

"Shares in the company first became publicly traded in 1988 following a listing by introduction. Since that time the company's shares have not been actively traded and investors have shown little interest in the company which has been loss-making since 1991 until a small profit was achieved in the year ended 31 March, 1996," CDW International said.
It said it would take time and money for benefits to be realised under a joint venture deal with France's Dollfus Mieg & Cie. CDW hold a stake in DMC and holds warrants to subscribe to more shares.

"CDW Holdings believes that the company does not have the financial resources to develop its dyeing and printing business in joint venture with DMC and the company would be unable to raise the money it needs for the further subscription of DMC shares and the development of its business in the future through the stock market," the company said.

"CDW Holdings considers it would be in the best interest of the company if it were to become a private company so that CDW Holdings can use its financial resources to finance the company's development."

It said the cancellation price of HK$1.20 for its shares represented a premium of about 53.8 percent over the five-day average closing price before trading in the shares was suspended. CDW International said the net asset value of the shares was about HK$1.08 per share.
On the basis of the cancellation price, the company said its entire issued share capital was valued at about HK$246.5 million.
Trading in CDW International shares is due to resume on Thursday.
The proposal is conditional on approval by minority shareholders and is expected to become effective before June 30, 1997.
